detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation via Hybrid Architectures and Goal Generation
detail.summary: Autonomous discovery systems face critical challenges in iterative experiment refinement and independent goal generation. Success in autonomous inquiry requires robust self-healing mechanisms to navigate failure loops, adaptive meta-strategies for resource-constrained exploration, and mechanisms for self-generated goals to accelerate skill acquisition in unpredictable environments.
detail.reason: Updating notebook to integrate GOAL-Robots findings on self-generated goals with existing meta-strategy and self-healing research.
